items.html: Daat is the first king to come out, and all seven were incorporated in him. You already know that the principal raising of MAN are the vessels that were already born in the world; hence, thus far, raising MAN was primarily through Daat that emerged in the world first. We have already explained that in the beginning, there was no need for MAN to AVI, only the ascension of the desire. When it is written that these seven kings were MAN, it does not mean that they drew Hassadim and Gevurot, since they have already been extended in the beginning. The evidence of this is that they returned AVI to face-to-face, and afterwards Hochma placed those seven kings in Bina. Thus, we cannot say that they were MAN to Bina. rather, it means that they placed them face-to-face to AVI through their raising of MAN, once they were already in Bina. Then they drew the Hassadim and Gevurot further as in the beginning. We shall return to the matter that after the light of Daat emerged and entered its vessel, it raised MAN and drew Hassadim and Gevurot in AVI. This is because Daat consists of Hassadim and Gevurot, and because the seven kings were incorporated in it at that time, it had the strength to lower Hassadim and Gevurot. However, since the rest of the kings do not raise MAN, since the emergence was still not to them, but to Daat, it is possible to lower complete Mochin only through ZON together. Therefore, what Daat lowered was the phases of Hassadim and Gevurot in the Rosh and upper AVI in the place of their Daat, resembling him, like him.
